script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: The card treats Samuel’s Ramah and the Ramah in the accounts of Baasha and Jeremiah as one city. The dictionaries list them separately; Samuel’s Ramah has a disputed location. The card should distinguish them rather than assume they are the same place.
“David runs to Samuel” suggests Saul reached Naioth before the Spirit came upon him. In 1 Samuel 19:23, the Spirit came upon Saul while he was on his way there.
“Jeremiah is freed” places the coming of the LORD’s word at Ramah. Jeremiah 40:1 says the word came after Jeremiah was released at Ramah, but does not say where he received it.
Some wording may be above a fifth-grade reading level, including “fortified,” “prophesied,” and “captives.” Use simpler words or brief explanations.
